# User stories: BookShelf

Actor: **Reader** (a person who keeps a list of the books they own; see `actors` in `profile.json`). Each story names the screen ids and routes it covers. Stories marked `ASSUMPTION:` describe behavior the code does not implement yet. Points and sprints match `sprints/sprint-plan.md`.

### US-001: Create an account

**Epic:** Auth | **Priority:** Must | **Points:** 3 | **Sprint:** 1

As a visitor, I want to create an account with my email and password, so that my books are kept under my own name.

Covers: screen `account-register`; route `POST /account/register`. (Today the handler only redirects; it does not create a user.)

**Acceptance criteria**
1. **Given** I am on Register, **when** I submit a new email and a password, **then** my account is created and I am taken to Login.
2. **Given** I am on Register, **when** I submit an email that is already registered, **then** I stay on Register and see an error message. *(negative case)*

### US-002: Sign in

**Epic:** Auth | **Priority:** Must | **Points:** 3 | **Sprint:** 1

As a reader, I want to sign in with my email and password, so that I can see my own books.

Covers: screen `account-login`; route `POST /account/login`. (Today the handler has a TODO and always redirects to My Books.)

**Acceptance criteria**
1. **Given** I have an account, **when** I submit my correct email and password, **then** I land on My Books.
2. **Given** I have an account, **when** I submit a wrong password, **then** I stay on Login and see an error message. *(negative case)*

### US-003: Protect the book pages

**Epic:** Auth | **Priority:** Must | **Points:** 2 | **Sprint:** 1

As a reader, I want my book pages to be visible only to signed-in users, so that nobody else can see or change my books.

Covers: screens `books-index`, `books-details`, `books-create`; routes under `/books`. (No `[Authorize]` was found on the controllers.)

**Acceptance criteria**
1. **Given** I am signed in, **when** I open My Books, **then** the page loads.
2. **Given** I am not signed in, **when** I open `/books`, **then** I am sent to Login instead of seeing any books. *(negative case)*

### US-004: See my books

**Epic:** Books | **Priority:** Must | **Points:** 5 | **Sprint:** 1

As a reader, I want to see a list of my books with title, author and status, so that I know what I own.

Covers: screen `books-index`; route `GET /books`. (Today the list is not filtered by `Book.UserId`.)

**Acceptance criteria**
1. **Given** I own two books, **when** I open My Books, **then** both appear with title, author and status.
2. **Given** another reader owns a book, **when** I open My Books, **then** that book is not shown. *(negative case)*

### US-005: Add a book

**Epic:** Books | **Priority:** Must | **Points:** 5 | **Sprint:** 1

As a reader, I want to add a book with its title, author and ISBN, so that it is on my list.

Covers: screen `books-create`; routes `GET /books/create`, `POST /books/create`.

**Acceptance criteria**
1. **Given** I am on Add a Book, **when** I submit a title, author and ISBN, **then** I return to My Books and the new book is listed.
2. **Given** I am on Add a Book, **when** I submit without a title, **then** I stay on the form and see an error message. *(negative case)*

### US-006: Sign out

**Epic:** Auth | **Priority:** Must | **Points:** 1 | **Sprint:** 2

As a reader, I want to sign out, so that nobody else can use my session on a shared device.

Covers: screen `books-index` (Sign out link); route `POST /account/logout`.

**Acceptance criteria**
1. **Given** I am signed in, **when** I choose Sign out, **then** my session ends and I am taken to Home.
2. **Given** I have signed out, **when** I open `/books`, **then** I am sent to Login. *(negative case)*

### US-007: View a book's details

**Epic:** Books | **Priority:** Must | **Points:** 2 | **Sprint:** 2

As a reader, I want to open a book to see its title, author, ISBN and status, so that I can check its details.

Covers: screen `books-details`; route `GET /books/{id}`.

**Acceptance criteria**
1. **Given** I own a book, **when** I choose it on My Books, **then** I see its title, author, ISBN and status.
2. **Given** a book id that does not exist or belongs to someone else, **when** I open it, **then** I see a "Book not found" message instead of an error page. *(negative case)*

### US-008: Delete a book

**Epic:** Books | **Priority:** Should | **Points:** 3 | **Sprint:** 2

As a reader, I want to delete a book from my list, so that my list stays accurate.

Covers: screen `books-details`; route `POST /books/{id}/delete`.

**Acceptance criteria**
1. **Given** I own a book, **when** I choose Delete on its details page, **then** I return to My Books and it is no longer listed.
2. **Given** a book that belongs to another reader, **when** I try to delete it, **then** nothing is deleted and I see "Book not found". *(negative case)*

### US-009: Friendly empty and error states

**Epic:** Books | **Priority:** Should | **Points:** 3 | **Sprint:** 2

As a reader, I want clear messages when I have no books or a page cannot load, so that I know what to do next.

Covers: screens `books-index--empty`, `books-index--error`, `books-details--error`. ASSUMPTION: these states are proposed; the current views render an empty table and no error handling.

**Acceptance criteria**
1. **Given** I have no books, **when** I open My Books, **then** I see "You have not added any books yet." and an Add your first book button.
2. **Given** the books cannot be loaded, **when** I open My Books, **then** I see an error message and a Try again button, not a server error page. *(negative case)*

### US-010: Update a book's reading status

**Epic:** Books | **Priority:** Should | **Points:** 3 | **Sprint:** 2

As a reader, I want to change a book's status (for example To read, Reading, Finished), so that my list shows my progress.

Covers: screen `books-details`. ASSUMPTION: the status values and this screen action are proposed; `Book.Status` exists but no route changes it.

**Acceptance criteria**
1. **Given** I own a book with status To read, **when** I change it to Reading and save, **then** My Books shows Reading for that book.
2. **Given** I submit a status that is not one of the allowed values, **when** I save, **then** the status is not changed and I see an error message. *(negative case)*

### US-011: Automated tests for sign-in and the book flow

**Epic:** Quality | **Priority:** Should | **Points:** 5 | **Sprint:** 2

As a developer, I want automated tests for sign-in and the book list, add and delete flows, so that changes do not break them silently.

Covers: routes `POST /account/login`, `GET /books`, `POST /books/create`, `POST /books/{id}/delete`. (No tests were found in the project.)

**Acceptance criteria**
1. **Given** the test suite, **when** it runs, **then** it checks successful sign-in, listing, adding and deleting a book.
2. **Given** the test suite, **when** it runs, **then** it also checks that a wrong password and another reader's book are rejected. *(negative case)*

### US-012: Add a review to a book

**Epic:** Reviews | **Priority:** Could | **Points:** 5 | **Sprint:** 3

As a reader, I want to rate a book from 1 to 5 and write a short review, so that I remember what I thought of it.

Covers: screen `books-details` (proposed form). ASSUMPTION: the `Review` entity exists (`BookId`, `Rating`, `Text`) but there is no controller, route or view for it.

**Acceptance criteria**
1. **Given** I own a book, **when** I submit a rating of 4 and some text, **then** the review is saved for that book.
2. **Given** I submit a rating outside 1 to 5, **when** I save, **then** no review is saved and I see an error message. *(negative case)*

### US-013: See reviews on a book

**Epic:** Reviews | **Priority:** Could | **Points:** 3 | **Sprint:** 3

As a reader, I want to see my reviews on a book's details page, so that I can reread what I wrote.

Covers: screen `books-details`. ASSUMPTION: depends on the proposed review feature (US-012).

**Acceptance criteria**
1. **Given** a book has a review, **when** I open its details, **then** the rating and text are shown.
2. **Given** a book has no reviews, **when** I open its details, **then** the page shows "No reviews yet" instead of an empty gap. *(negative case)*
